name: Natural Hair Dyes
description:
We've all been there - you thought it was a great idea to dye your hair Hot Pink, or bright Neon Green. But now the colors are fading, and it's way more upkeep than you thought, and you just want to go back to your roots! Literally.


The Natural Hair Dyes set has you covered. Let your Dolly get back to basics, and let their natural beauty shine! Also, if you enjoy the colors for your Dollys hair, remember that you can additionally use these colors throughout your entire look!


Owning this unlocks the following set of Hunnys Closet dyes (for use on all Hunnys Closet items):

Dye: 3 Auburn colors

Dye: 5 Brown colors

Dye: 3 Blonde colors

Dye: 4 Orangeish colors


All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the Hunnys Closet: https://closet.hunnys.io 


As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the Hunnys Closet, it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
